acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for rotted window frame repair in areas like Daly City or Pacifica, look for a general contractor with specific experience in window and wood rot remediation. Verify they are licensed and insured in California. Request references, review their portfolio, and ensure they offer a detailed estimate that outlines the scope of work and materials. A contractor familiar with local building codes and climate challenges will provide the most reliable service.
